baseline_models.mechanism: The prohibition targets a human act of rendering or naming something as a worshipped other alongside God; it need not imply that humans can bring a real divine peer into existence.

activation_trace.role: Rendering something into a state anchors deityhood as an assigned status.
Calling or naming supplies a second mode by which the rival status can be made.
Worship and the worshipped identify the relational status being assigned.
Other-than-the-first supplies the added rival relation.

changed_reading.before: Do not worship a second divine object.
changed_reading.after: Do not perform the status-making or naming act that installs any worshipped other alongside God.

baseline_models.mechanism: The warning does more than transmit intelligible information: it exposes danger and separates a permissible orientation from the rival relation just prohibited.

activation_trace.role: Danger-announcement that awakens caution supplies the warning's urgency.
Manifest disclosure supplies the warning's clarity.
Separation supplies the functional boundary produced by that disclosure.

changed_reading.before: The speaker is an easily understood warner.
changed_reading.after: The speaker exposes the danger clearly enough to draw a practical boundary against rival-making.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earlier Moses scene couples sending and compelling warrant with the same disclosure root, sharpening the focus warning as an authorized commission rather than a self-originated alarm.

activation_trace.role: Danger-announcement anchors the focus speaker's warning function.
Messenger and message supply a commissioned source for the warning.
Compelling proof supplies warrant rather than coercive force alone.
Disclosure through expression or sign makes the warrant communicable.

structural_cues: 51:38 binds sending, warrant, and mubin before the focus repeats mubin in its warning formula.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the commissioned Moses scene and the repeated disclosure root; I infer that it frames the focus speaker's authority, while the live alternative is that mubin in 51:38 qualifies only the warrant.

changed_reading.after: A commissioned messenger delivers an evidentially warranted warning from God.

context_deltas.mechanism: The narratives stage strong flank, collective force, bodily standing, and self-defense, then remove all of them; this makes an added deity legible as an imagined auxiliary support whose promised function fails.

activation_trace.role: The worshipped object anchors the rival support in the focus relation.
The added other supplies the supposed auxiliary beside God.
A strong side leaned upon supplies the political image of auxiliary reliance.
A mutually supporting host expands the imagined protective apparatus.
Bodily standing supplies the minimum capacity that judgment removes.
Aid that makes one prevail supplies the failed defensive function.

structural_cues: 51:39 begins with reliance on a strong flank, while 51:45 closes the sequence with neither standing nor self-defense.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies relied-on supports and their collapse; I infer that the focus construction 'with God' invites a functional analogy to installing divine backup, while the alternative is that these supports only illustrate failed resistance.

changed_reading.before: Another deity is simply an additional cult object.
changed_reading.after: Another deity is also an imagined backup flank or protective apparatus placed beside God, a function the preceding collapses expose as empty.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context displays effective transformation, building, and creation, whereas the prohibited human making can only confer a name or status; the contrast turns rival deity-making into a counterfeit use of constructive language.

activation_trace.role: Making or bringing forth supplies the ontological pole tested by the context.
Rendering into a status supplies the limited human operation retained after the contrast.
Actual transformation into a new condition gives the repeated verb concrete causal force.
Decay and disintegration specify the real resulting state.
Joining parts into a built whole supplies ordered constructive efficacy.
Originating creation reserves genuine bringing-into-being for the divine side of the contrast.

structural_cues: 51:42 repeats the focus verb for a realized transformation; 51:47 and 51:49 then attribute building and creation to the divine voice.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies realized transformation, cosmic building, and creation; I infer an agentive asymmetry in which human god-making is status assignment, while the alternative is that focus ja'ala merely means placing without an ontological contrast.

changed_reading.before: Humans are forbidden to make a second divine being.
changed_reading.after: Humans cannot originate a divine peer; they can only counterfeit divine making by rendering or naming something as deity.

context_deltas.mechanism: Universal pairing is explicitly located inside the field of created things, and the immediate ban on an 'other' beside God blocks projection of that creaturely dyad onto the Creator.

activation_trace.role: The worshipped divine referent anchors the category boundary.
Another alongside the first supplies the prohibited projection of a pair.
Comprehensive totality sets the breadth of the created field.
The knowable thing supplies the members over which the totality ranges.
Origination marks the paired field as created rather than divine.
A counterpart joined to its fellow supplies the dyadic pattern.
Recollection makes the created pattern a prompt for recognition, not a template for God.

structural_cues: 51:49 states created pairing, 51:50 directs flight to God, and 51:51 forbids adding an other beside God.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies created totality, pairing, and immediate exclusive commands; I infer that the Creator is outside the paired class, while the live alternative is that pairing serves only as a general reminder without an anti-projection function.

changed_reading.before: Do not add a second member to the class of gods.
changed_reading.after: Do not misapply the paired architecture of created things to God by imagining a divine counterpart.

context_deltas.mechanism: The adjacent positive command establishes one destination, and the focus prohibition closes off a second; the repeated warning coda makes the two ayat a directional route plus boundary.

activation_trace.role: The added other anchors the forbidden second endpoint.
Urgent flight supplies movement away from danger toward refuge.
The worshipped God is made the sole destination of that movement.
Danger-announcement provides the urgency driving the flight.
Explicit disclosure makes the route intelligible.

structural_cues: 51:50 and 51:51 share the same warning coda while pairing a positive destination with a negative exclusion.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies adjacent imperatives and an identical coda; I infer a coordinated two-step route, while the alternative is that the ayat are parallel exhortations without a single spatial mechanism.

changed_reading.before: Exclusive worship is a static proposition.
changed_reading.after: Exclusive worship is an urgent routing act: flee toward God and refuse every second endpoint installed beside Him.

context_deltas.mechanism: The same dismissive labels recur around messengers and are then described as if mutually transmitted; this activates focus ja'ala as naming and shows rival-making operating through inherited speech that reclassifies true authority.

activation_trace.role: Calling or naming anchors the discursive mode of making in the focus.
Worshipped authority supplies the status redistributed by hostile naming.
Attributing what is not so supplies the false classificatory speech act.
Diversion and deception supply one label used to displace the message.
Covered reason supplies the alternative label that voids the messenger's credibility.
Messenger and message identify the repeatedly misclassified authority.
Reciprocal bequeathing supplies the image of labels transmitted across groups.
Boundary-crossing rebellion supplies the deeper continuity beneath the repeated labels.

structural_cues: The exact sorcerer-or-madman pair recurs in 51:39 and 51:52, followed by the question of mutual bequeathing in 51:53.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies false labels, their recurrence, and the bequest question; I infer that hostile naming is the same human status-making activated by ja'ala, while the alternative is that the labels mark rejection without themselves constructing rival worship.

changed_reading.before: Making another god is material or cultic fabrication.
changed_reading.after: Rival-making can begin as inherited speech: rename the true messenger, displace his authority, and thereby clear space for another object of allegiance.

context_deltas.mechanism: Withdrawal without blame and renewed reminding coexist because warning discloses rather than compels; its benefit becomes conditional on a receptive, trusting hearer.

activation_trace.role: Danger-announcement anchors the speaker's bounded task.
Disclosure through expression defines the task as making meaning available.
Turning away supplies a legitimate endpoint to unreceived warning.
Removal of deserved blame limits responsibility for the hearer's refusal.
A reminder that prompts recollection preserves a noncoercive continued address.
Benefit rather than harm names the reminder's realized effect.
Heart-settling assent supplies the receptive condition for benefit.

structural_cues: 51:54 commands withdrawal and removes blame; 51:55 immediately restores reminding for those able to benefit.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies withdrawal, blamelessness, renewed reminder, and selective benefit; I infer a receptivity-dependent warning task, while the alternative is a change of audience rather than a general account of warning.

changed_reading.before: A clear warner bears responsibility to secure assent.
changed_reading.after: A clear warner is responsible for disclosure, may withdraw without blame from refusal, and continues reminding where trust makes benefit possible.

context_deltas.mechanism: Worship is followed by a denial that creatures provision or feed God and by identifying God as the strong provider; deityhood is therefore nonextractive and reverses any cultic economy in which worshippers sustain their god.

activation_trace.role: Worship and the worshipped anchor the relation whose economy is clarified.
Submissive worship supplies the creature's purpose and direction of service.
Allocated provision is explicitly denied as a transfer needed from creatures.
Feeding another supplies the rejected maintenance model.
The named worshipped God identifies the independent source in the reversal.
Allocated giving now flows from God rather than toward Him.
Concentrated strength removes any need for creaturely supplementation.
Extended solidity gives that independence durable force.

structural_cues: 51:56 gives worship as purpose, 51:57 denies provision and feeding from creatures, and 51:58 identifies God as provider and strength.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies worship, denied creaturely maintenance, and divine provision; I infer a contrast with extractive deity-models, while the alternative is that the sequence asserts self-sufficiency without characterizing how rival cults function.

changed_reading.before: Exclusive worship means serving only one deity.
changed_reading.after: Exclusive worship serves the one non-needy provider and rejects every deity-model sustained by tribute, feeding, or transferred strength.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because ءَاخَرَ ordinarily marks another, not an act of postponement; the same focus root and the context's waiting, non-hastening, and appointed day keep a temporal resonance live, but downstream prose should present it as a functional echo rather than substitute 'delayed' for the adjective.

activation_trace.role: Deferral to a later time supplies the exploratory temporal potential within the focus root.
Extended enjoyment supplies a temporary interval in which response can be deferred.
Waiting for the appointed time supplies explicit temporal suspension.
Hastening and bringing forward supply the negated opposite of deferral.
A bounded span of time supplies the horizon at which delay ends.
An appointed time for a promise fixes the deferred encounter.

changed_reading.before: An other deity is an additional object.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, installing an other deity also functions as a device for postponing the exclusive claim until the promised time can no longer be deferred.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the material image of an allotted or full bucket appears in 51:59 rather than in the focus warning itself; the focus roots for warning and disclosure keep the model anchored, and the matched share makes the threat inspectable, but downstream prose should call it a context-activated material analogy, not the lexical meaning of نَذِيرٌ.

activation_trace.role: Danger-announcement anchors the model in the focus warning.
Manifest disclosure anchors the claim that the warned consequence is made inspectable.
An allotted share supplies the measured consequence announced by the warning.
A full bucket supplies the material image of a filled portion coming due.
A matching counterpart supplies the rule by which the share corresponds to predecessors.
Companionship and association identify the historical group whose portion is matched.
Threatened promise carries the measured share forward to its announced realization.

changed_reading.before: The focus ends with a generic warning of danger.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, it is notice of a measured share already patterned by predecessors, like a filled allotment whose delivery is promised.

strongest_changes: Context separates effective transformation, building, and creation from the human act of assigning or naming deity-status.
Created pairing immediately becomes a boundary against projecting a divine counterpart onto God.
The repeated messenger labels reveal rival-making as an inherited speech practice as well as a cultic act.
The adjacent flight command turns exclusivity into a route toward one destination, and the worship-provision sequence makes that destination nonextractive.
summary.what_was_special: The focus ayah became a category and agency boundary: creatures can pair, name, rely, and defer, but they cannot create a peer, provision God, or establish a second refuge. Its repeated warning coda holds these readings together without collapsing them.
remaining_uncertainties: The anti-pairing reading depends on sequence and the inferred exclusion of the Creator from the class of created things.
The naming model depends on activating a valid but nonexclusive branch of ج ع ل in this construction.
The temporal ء خ ر and bucket-share ذ ن ب models are contained resonances rather than direct replacements for the focus words.
